reservoir_evaluation.name: Venturi Self-Powering
reservoir_evaluation.original_kill_reason: Physics risk — Venturi effect in CSF may not harvest useful power (P-08 falsification: CSF kinetic 0.62 nW)

admission_gate_check.1_mechanism_defined: YES — Venturi constriction converts CSF flow to pressure differential for energy harvesting
admission_gate_check.3_first_experiment_concrete: YES — model Venturi pressure differential from CSF flow
admission_gate_check.4_economic_mechanism: YES — eliminates battery replacement surgeries ($35-50K each)
admission_gate_check.5_no_fatal_blocker: CONDITIONAL — P-08 falsified CSF kinetic harvesting at 0.62 nW, but Venturi uses pressure differential (different mechanism). Need to verify the mechanism is genuinely different.

P-08_cross_check.P-08_mechanism: CSF kinetic energy harvesting (turbine/piezo from flow)
P-08_cross_check.theoretical_venturi_power: dP = 0.5 * rho * v^2 * (1-(A2/A1)^2). For CSF v=0.01m/s, rho=1000, A2/A1=0.3: dP = 0.05 Pa. Power = dP * Q = 0.05 * 5e-9 = 0.25 nW. STILL BELOW USEFUL.
P-08_cross_check.verdict: VENTURI IS ALSO FALSIFIED by P-08 physics. CSF flow (0.3 mL/min = 5e-9 m³/s) is too low for any flow-based energy harvesting, whether kinetic or Venturi.

reservoir_evaluation.decision: NOT PROMOTED — P-08 cross-check falsifies Venturi mechanism too. CSF flow is fundamentally too low for flow-based energy harvesting.

decision: Both reservoir candidates fail admission gate. R-CM-01 has unresolved prior art. R-CM-02 is falsified by P-08 physics (CSF flow too low for any flow-based harvesting).

alternative_action.option: Leave P-18 slot VACANT rather than promote a candidate that will fail.
alternative_action.rationale: Article XXXVI §11: 'Do not create a new candidate merely to inflate the count.' Promoting a candidate we know will fail is worse than leaving the slot vacant.

alternative_action.CEO_notification: Reservoir exhausted. No credible replacement available. CEO may either (a) provide a new candidate from external source, or (b) accept 14 active for now.

reusable_knowledge_from_reservoir_evalua.R-CM-01: Osmotic valve concept is blocked by US20020087111. Any osmotic-pressure-driven passive valve needs to differentiate from this patent before promotion.
reusable_knowledge_from_reservoir_evalua.R-CM-02: Venturi self-powering is falsified by the same physics that killed P-08. CSF flow (0.3 mL/min) is too low for ANY flow-based energy harvesting (kinetic OR Venturi). Future self-powering candidates must use non-flow energy sources (cardiac motion like P-15, thermal gradient, or external RF like P-16).
